purpose: Prevent silent reduction of the complete Actions/ETF/Gold decision referentials and universe while horizon weights and overlays evolve separately.

actions.rule: All 633 master rows remain part of the referential. V21.3 derived factors are additive decision layers and never delete source criteria. All 1829 exact Action ISINs are retained for collection/scoring subject to data quality gates.

etf.rule: All 268 rows remain part of the master referential, including Morningstar, yield, TER, AUM, risk, tracking/replication and diversification. Generic horizons renormalize available criteria; the exact 38-criterion MT reference core remains separately attributable until a dynamic challenger is validated.

gold.rule: All 102 Gold criteria remain traceable. Missing data stay MISSING. No performance claim until dedicated PIT backtest.

dynamic_weighting.tct_setup_exception: SETUP is intentionally inactive, not missing; active available TCT pillars renormalize to 100% in V24.1.8
